∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] {Q : Type u_2} [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{u_2 + 1} Q] [inst_2 : Quiver.{u_3, u_2} Q]
  {i : Q} (hi : Etingof.IsSink.{u_2, u_3} Q i)
  (ρ : Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.{u_1, u_2, max (max u_2 u_3) u_4, u_3} k Q)
  [∀ (v : Q),
      Module.Free.{u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_4} k
        (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u_1, u_2, max (max u_2 u_3) u_4, u_3} ρ v)]
  [∀ (v : Q),
      Module.Finite.{u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_4} k
        (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u_1, u_2, max (max u_2 u_3) u_4, u_3} ρ v)],
  Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsIndecomposable.{u_1, u_2, u_3, max (max u_2 u_3) u_4} ρ →
    Or
      (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsIndecomposable.{u_1, u_2, u_3, max (max u_2 u_3) u_4}
        (Etingof.reflectionFunctorPlus.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} Q i hi ρ))
      (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsZero.{u_1, u_2, u_3, max (max u_2 u_3) u_4}
        (Etingof.reflectionFunctorPlus.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} Q i hi ρ))
